about: The world has fallen. Hordes of monsters rage in its ruins, their waves only growing more violent. You are the last line of defense. Take matters into your own hands and prove that humanity will not go down without a fight.

Your fortress is your life. Build fortifications to slow down the creatures and deploy turrets to turn them into mincemeat. Your arsenal has everything you need to survive: from a reliable pistol and a powerful grenade launcher to a bloody axe and deadly knives.

Level up using coins dropped by defeated enemies. With each new wave, you will become stronger, faster, and more deadly. But don't forget to keep an eye on your health—one mistake can cost you everything.
The main goal is to survive. And for those looking for a real challenge, we've prepared 10 hardcore achievements. Can you unlock them all and prove you're a true monster hunter?
